title: Candidates pass or fail exact support
narration: It compares candidate support and checks every claim field.
concept: A candidate must support exact claim fields rather than merely share a topic.
visualEvent: Four passage carriers align; one enters exact-support inspection and one mismatch exits through a visible rejected branch.
cameraInstruction: One continuous left-to-right truck along the brass comparison rail; no cut or second move.

title: A human receives a source-linked record
narration: Then it records the source for human review.
concept: The system records reviewable evidence without approving or releasing the claim.
visualEvent: A reviewer verifies the source attachment; the hinged pair closes into one record and enters the archive as the loop returns.
cameraInstruction: One calm dolly backward revealing the human boundary, record drawer, and returning paper stack; no cut.
